answer: A work-bonded reputation reef resists Sybil attacks by making each identity earn trust through verifiable, costly tasks before it can trade. New agents start with a jade badge that limits transaction size, and only sustained honest work raises the limit. If an agent cheats, its bond is slashed and its history is marked, so creating many fake identities costs more than the delta between honest profit and fraud gains. Attackers must pay repeatedly for each identity, while honest agents reuse one proven record.
